en.title: The Secondhand Bookstore 'Sunlit Bookmark' and the Gift of Stopped Time
en.premise: One day, an old, broken pocket watch and a book about a journey through the desert arrive at the secondhand bookstore run by "me." The owner's wish is to find the person they made a promise to on "that day"—the very day the watch stopped. Following the small clues hidden within the pages, the stories of stopped time and the misunderstandings of the heart slowly begin to unravel.

zh.title: 古书店“向阳书签”与停滞时间的礼物
zh.premise: 经营着一家古书店的“我”，在某天收到了一块停止走动的旧怀表和一本关于沙漠之旅的书。委托人的愿望，是希望能找到在怀表停下的“那一天”所许下约定的那个人。循着隐藏在书中的细微线索，停滞的时间与心灵的错位将慢慢被解开。
